title: The Effects of Real-Time Feedback on Effort and Performance: Evidence from a Natural Quasi-Experiment
authors: Maximilian Margolin; Marko Reimer; Daniel Schaupp

ineligible_specs.reported_location: Tables 5-7 (initial decisions, final decisions, interruptions; full sample and by experience)
ineligible_specs.exclusion_reason: single adoption date (VAR introduced in the 1st Division from the 2017-18 season; 2nd Division control); game-level time-varying controls game_close and game_important; no calendar-time FE (VAR_PERIOD dummy only)
same single-date design; effort variables (DISTANCE, SPEED, RUNS) withheld under NDA
event study around one common date

eligible_reason: Not staggered. Treatment is the Video Assistant Referee, introduced for all 1st Division games at the start of the 2017-18 season; 2nd Division games (VAR only from 2019-20) are the control group. Sample is one season before and one after (1,224 referee-games). Equation (1): DV on VAR_GROUP x VAR_PERIOD with referee FE and game controls, SEs clustered by referee. One common adoption date, so no eligible column.
design_notes: analysis.do: reg y i.var_group##i.var_period game_close game_important i.referee, vce(cluster referee); subsamples experienced==0/1; event study with tmin4..tplus4 quarter-season dummies interacted with var_group.
data_files_note: dataset.dta (1,224 games x 41 vars) shipped; referee effort variables (DFB data under NDA) removed, so Table 4 cannot be replicated.
data_provenance_note: Original game-level data minus the NDA effort variables.
software_notes: analysis.do (analysis_incl_effort.do mentioned in readme but not in the extracted package)
screener_notes: Published PDF read (data/text/mnsc/mnsc.2022.02084.txt). Single common date; clear exclusion.
